scene: 19:07 on the night of incident 4655, when an operator kept moving the console divider while the workers were still writing: first a nudge of a couple of columns, then a proper drag to put the two panes side by side, then a wider reading minimum for the shift lead. The on-call had stopped inside one of the entries before any of it, and her note of where she stopped and where the pane put her after the drag is beside the session, together with the incident file the exporter wrote and the number of lines it gave several of the entries at some of those widths.
